games.desc:
🐴 Welcome to Horse RNG 🐴 

Buy food from the shop, breed your horses, unlock unique & rare breeds, and then sell or race them to make money!

Your horses literally grow up while you're offline!

games.name: [UPD]  Cave Diving Experience
games.desc:
Squeeze through realistic tight caves, mine rare ores, and upgrade your pickaxe in this deep cave diving adventure!

Explore underwater caves, lava zones, and geothermal tunnels. Collect copper, iron, diamond, emerald, mythril and more. Use scuba gear, thermal protection, and enchants to push deeper.

Fully compatible on Mobile, Tablet, PC, Console & VR.

Features:
• Realistic cave crawling & ragdoll physics
• Ore mining + pickaxe progression
• Scuba diving & heat protection
• Unique caves (Atlantis, Diving Bell, Catacombs & more)
• Cave Rescue system

How deep can you go?

games.name: Zach's Service Station
games.desc:
Zach's Service Station is a game about running a city-side Gas Station with up to 12 friends.

Manage the stations stock, maintain the Station and complete customer's requests to keep a high rating to fight back the ever-increasing amount of bills.

Unlock and Customize your character's clothing and accessories to make it unique and specialized in the different tasks needed to be done.

Running a business in the city ain't easy, but teamwork will prevail.
Good Luck, Clerks!
